documentation:
## Edge Damage Slice

### What it does
This graph is a method for creating edge damage on convex geometry.

### Inputs and outputs
This graph is self-contained, the mesh is a platonic primitive.  The output is the generated mesh, with broken up edges.

### How it works
This system works by creating a subdivided plane along each edge of any convex polygon, displacing that plane and then using ***boolean_meshes*** in *slice* mode to chip off parts of each edge. 

**Note:**  as this method loops over every edge of the input object, it is suited for lower-resolution meshes and will be slow on a mesh with a high edge/face count.

_notes.text:
# ***edge_damage_slice***

This system works by creating a subdivided plane along each edge of any convex polygon, displacing that plane and then using ***boolean_meshes*** in *slice* mode to chip off parts of each edge.  

There are two possible outputs:
- all objects (*mesh_parts* output on ***boolean_meshes***):  this will output both the base mesh and the "chips" of the edges. This is useful for further voronoi/destruction work
- base mesh only: (*largest_object* on ***get_largest_component*** compound) outputs only the mesh being chipped.   This is useful for modelling.

**Note:**  as this method loops over every edge of the input object, it is suited for lower-resolution meshes and will be slow on a mesh with a high edge/face count.

## ***prepare_planes***

This is an *auto-looping* compound that loops over every edge and adds a cutting plane.  The plane is displaced based on the inputs.
By looping through each pair of adjacent faces and averaging the face normals, the edge normals are derived.

_backdrops.title: Get edge normals from adjacent faces

_notes.text:
Apply transforms to each point, from bottom to top: 
1. Translate points from source to the origin 
2. Rotate points from source orientation to destination orientation 
3. Scale points with destination scaling 
4. Translate the points from the origin to dst

_backdrops.title: Get Edge points by neighbor count
Replace displaced edge points with base edge points
Build the transform matrix from the edge normals, binormals, tangents and centers

_notes.text: Feel free to replace this section with your own convex geo

## ***prepare_planes***

This is an *auto-looping* compound that loops over every edge and adds a cutting plane.  The plane is displaced based on the inputs.

Apply transforms to each point, from bottom to top: 
1. Translate points from source to the origin 
2. Rotate points from source orientation to destination orientation 
3. Scale points with destination scaling 
4. Translate the points from the origin to dst
